Detailed bio-data highlighting scientific and translational contributions in detail.
A brief bio-data in the proforma given in the advertisement (may also be sent).

An additional pro-forma in Word file format, sent with the application: name, address and DOB; qualification and specialisation; experience (in chronological order); honours/awards; number of publications/patents; list of 05 referees.
The prescribed bio-data proforma asks for:
Name of the laboratory applied/nominated for, name, date of birth, current position and address.
Educational qualification (degree/certificate, year of passing, university/institute, subjects) and academic/research experience/employment.
Areas of specialisation, honours/awards/recognitions and professional affiliations.
Research publications, best professional outputs in the last 10 years, highlights of contributions, books authored/edited, patents/IPR, technologies developed, licensed or commercialised.
Dissertations supervised (Ph.D. and post-graduation) and a 1–2 page summary of vision as Leader of CSIR-CGCRI.
Five professional referees of high repute, a signed declaration, date and place (details may be enclosed separately).

In its covering letter dated 26 October 2026, the Director General, CSIR asks recipients to nominate suitable scientists/technologists and send their Curriculum Vitae by 30.11.2026 to [email protected] and [email protected]. If a CV is not readily available, the nominee's contact address, email and telephone number may be sent. Nominators are asked to ascertain the availability and willingness of the persons before submitting their CVs.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: CSIR's covering letter says the Director must be an accomplished scientist/technologist, a thinker and a visionary with a passion to serve society through high science and technological innovation, with the required R&D experience in the areas of the institute's activities and demonstrated leadership. Ph.D. in Natural Sciences, or Master's Degree in Engineering (for Engineering, Ph.D. is desirable). At least 16 years of experience in Research and Development (with focus on translational research) in the areas of activities of the laboratory/Institutes/Centre, and demonstrated excellence in leadership therein. Years of experience are computed from the beginning of the candidate's research career. Ph.D. for candidates applying with a Master's Degree in Engineering. A creative, innovative and well-recognised scientist/technologist with a demonstrated ability to manage multidisciplinary R&D teams, with excellent interpersonal relations. Significant contributions in technology development, apart from creation of IP and publications. Ability to create a conducive environment for nurturing high-class research and development. The age limit is 45 years or above but not exceeding 56 years. The notice does not print a cut-off date for counting age. The qualifications, age and experience can be relaxed in the case of exceptionally meritorious candidates with the approval of DG, CSIR. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: Pay: Level 15 of Pay Matrix (Rs.1,82,200 – 2,24,100) with allowances as admissible. Tenure: Six years or till superannuation, whichever is earlier. Renewal: The tenure period will be renewable only in exceptional cases. Absorption: The Director can be considered for absorption/placement in CSIR as Director's Grade Scientist, i.e. Scientist 'H'/Outstanding Scientist, as per rules. Share of external earnings: The provision to share money realised from external contract R&D, consultancy and rendering of S&T services is available as per extant rules. Housing and transport: Residential accommodation and transport are provided as per rules. Medical and other facilities: Provided as per CSIR rules.

content_sections.heading: CSIR Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: The Director shall supervise and exercise administrative control on the staff of the Institute and shall be responsible for: realising the mission of the Institute; and creating an environment conducive to nurture innovation and high-class R&D and other S&T activities of the Laboratory/Institute in keeping with societal/industrial priorities.

The last date of receipt of applications is 30 November 2026. The prescribed bio-data proforma asks for: Name of the laboratory applied/nominated for, name, date of birth, current position and address. Educational qualification (degree/certificate, year of passing, university/institute, subjects) and academic/research experience/employment. Areas of specialisation, honours/awards/recognitions and professional affiliations. Dissertations supervised (Ph.D. and post-graduation) and a 1–2 page summary of vision as Leader of CSIR-CGCRI. Five professional referees of high repute, a signed declaration, date and place (details may be enclosed separately). In its covering letter dated 26 October 2026, the Director General, CSIR asks recipients to nominate suitable scientists/technologists and send their Curriculum Vitae by 30.11.2026 to [email protected] and [email protected] . If a CV is not readily available, the nominee's contact address, email and telephone number may be sent. Nominators are asked to ascertain the availability and willingness of the persons before submitting their CVs.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date for the CSIR-CGCRI Director application?
faq.answer: Applications and nominations must be received by 30 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What qualification is required for Director, CSIR-CGCRI?
faq.answer: A Ph.D. in Natural Sciences or a Master's Degree in Engineering is required; for Engineering, a Ph.D. is desirable.

faq.question: Q3. How much experience is needed?
faq.answer: At least 16 years of R&D experience (with focus on translational research) in the laboratory's areas of activity, with demonstrated excellence in leadership, counted from the start of the research career.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the CSIR-CGCRI Director post?
faq.answer: Candidates must be 45 years or above but not exceeding 56 years, and age can be relaxed for exceptionally meritorious candidates with the approval of DG, CSIR.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of the CSIR-CGCRI Director?
faq.answer: The post is in Level 15 of the Pay Matrix (Rs.1,82,200 – 2,24,100) with allowances as admissible.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for the CSIR Director post?
faq.answer: Send the application with detailed bio-data and a list of publications/patents by email to [email protected] or by post to the Director Recruitment Cell, CSIR, Anusandhan Bhawan, 2, Rafi Marg, New Delhi-110001.

faq.question: Q7. How will the Director be selected?
faq.answer: CVs are placed before the Search-cum-Selection Committee for consideration.

faq.question: Q8. Is the Director appointment permanent?
faq.answer: No, it is a tenure of six years or till superannuation, whichever is earlier, renewable only in exceptional cases; the Director can be considered for absorption as Scientist 'H'/Outstanding Scientist as per rules.

faq.question: Q9. Can someone else be nominated for the post?
faq.answer: Yes, CSIR invites nominations of suitable scientists/technologists, with their CVs sent to [email protected] and [email protected] by 30.11.2026, after checking their availability and willingness.
